plugin.name: kflow
plugin.description: Reads a Linux kernel's own __bug_table, __jump_table and __ex_table: comments every BUG/WARN trap with its source file:line (WARN = execution continues), every static-key site with its key and branch target, and every faulting instruction with its fixup, and adds the missing jump references. x86_64 and aarch64. Not yet run in real IDA.
